title: Anduril wordmark
description: A small line emblem beside a bold, tight, all-caps wordmark in the theme's grotesk, as the header and footer use it.
notes: pass your own emblem (a lucide icon or an svg); it is drawn in the text colour
name: anduril-wordmark

props.name: emblem
props.description: the emblem, e.g. a lucide icon; drawn in the text colour

props.name: name
props.description: the brand name, set in bold capitals

props.name: href
props.description: link target (usually the home page); leave out for a plain mark

props.name: size
props.description: larger mark, as in the footer
